messages.content: Mobile streaming spec: first_token_latency p50 <= 280ms, p95 <= 900ms. Chunk size target 24-48 characters. partial_flush must run every 120ms or 3 chunks, whichever comes first. Offline queue max 200 requests. Battery overhead must stay below 4%. Crash-free sessions >= 99.7%. Feature flag: streaming_v2_ios.
